reason: I'd grab the 14-day trial for sure since there's no auto-charge, but I always try things and then don't pay. And YouTube rain sounds are already free, so the free version's 30/60-minute timer is probably good enough for me.
objection: Two weeks of my messy sleep, with my phone guessing when I fell asleep, can't really prove anything. Even if it says I fell asleep 5 minutes faster, I won't know if that's real or just a number.
would_change_my_mind: If the comparison showed I got back to sleep a lot faster after waking at night, like 15+ minutes, on most nights, I'd pay the monthly 4,900 for a month to check.
